name: PhaKIR Dataset
description: A dataset of laparoscopic cholecystectomy videos with annotations for surgical phase recognition, instrument instance segmentation, and instrument keypoint estimation.
citation: Rueckert, T. et al. Comparative validation of surgical phase recognition, instrument keypoint estimation, and instrument instance segmentation in endoscopy: Results of the PhaKIR 2024 challenge. arXiv:2507.16559 (2025). https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.16559

license.notes: Dataset is identified as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 by the PhaKIR challenge site and Zenodo record. Dataset access requires approval.
